facts.statement: Seven is a rummy-style card game.
facts.sourceSentence: Seven is a rummy-style card game for 1 to 7 players that plays in about 7 minutes, and is recommended for ages 7 and up.

facts.statement: Each player receives a Ways to Score card during setup.
facts.sourceSentence: Give each player a "Ways to Score" card.

facts.statement: Each player draws 3 cards from the center pool during setup to form their initial hand.
facts.sourceSentence: Each player should then draw 3 cards from the mess to form their hand.

facts.statement: Each player draws 2 cards into their hand each round.

facts.statement: Each player discards 1 card from their hand each round.
facts.sourceSentence: Each player discards 1 card from their hand face-up off to the side of the table in their own discard pile.

facts.statement: Discarded cards are placed face-up off to the side of the table in each player's own discard pile.

facts.statement: At game end, a player will have accumulated 7 discards.
facts.sourceSentence: If you ever lose track of which round you are on, count your discards, you will have 7 discards when the game is over.

facts.statement: The game ends when all players have 10 cards in hand.

facts.statement: Each player scores their best hand of 7 cards.

facts.statement: A match consists of 7 games of Seven.
Players keep track of each player's score total across all games.
facts.sourceSentence: Play 7 games and keep track of each player's score total.

facts.statement: The player with the highest total score at the end of the match wins.
facts.sourceSentence: Whichever player has the highest total score at the end of the match wins!

facts.statement: Shorter matches can be played as a best of 3 games.
facts.sourceSentence: That said, if you would like a shorter or longer match, feel free to play a match as a best of 3 games or a best of 10 games.
